title: Spotify listening
description: Every song played on Spotify: recorded by the playlist generator, plus imported data exports (github.com/QuinnBast/SpotifyPlaylistGenerator).

panels.title: Hours listened

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(round(sum(seconds) / 3600.0, 1), 0) FROM v_plays WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at)

panels.description: Data-export plays count the time actually played; recorded plays count the song's length (Spotify only lists plays of 30 s or more).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM v_plays WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at)

panels.title: Songs

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT (lower(artist), lower(track_name))) FROM v_plays WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at)

panels.description: Different songs played.

panels.title: Artists

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT lower(artist)) FROM v_plays WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at)

panels.description: Different main artists played.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT max(artist) || ' · ' || count(*) || ' plays' FROM v_plays WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at) GROUP BY lower(artist) ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1), '-')

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT max(track_name) || ' – ' || max(artist) || ' · ' || count(*) || ' plays' FROM v_plays WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at) GROUP BY lower(artist), lower(track_name) ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1), '-')

panels.title: Current streak

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT days || CASE WHEN days = 1 THEN ' day' ELSE ' days' END FROM ( WITH days AS (SELECT DISTINCT local_time::date AS d FROM v_plays WHERE true), runs AS (SELECT d, d - (row_number() OVER (ORDER BY d))::integer AS run FROM days) SELECT count(*) AS days, min(d) AS first_day, max(d) AS last_day FROM runs GROUP BY run) s WHERE last_day >= (now() AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM settings))::date - 1), '0 days')

panels.description: Days in a row with music, up to today (or yesterday, if you haven't listened yet today). Not limited by the time range.

panels.title: Longest streak

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT days || ' days · ' || to_char(first_day, 'DD Mon YYYY') || ' – ' || to_char(last_day, 'DD Mon YYYY') FROM ( WITH days AS (SELECT DISTINCT local_time::date AS d FROM v_plays WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at)), runs AS (SELECT d, d - (row_number() OVER (ORDER BY d))::integer AS run FROM days) SELECT count(*) AS days, min(d) AS first_day, max(d) AS last_day FROM runs GROUP BY run) s ORDER BY days DESC, last_day DESC LIMIT 1), '-')

panels.description: The most days in a row with music, in the selected time range.

panels.title: Days with music

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT local_time::date) / GREATEST(1, (($__timeTo())::date - ($__timeFrom())::date)), 0) FROM v_plays WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at)

panels.description: Share of the days in the selected range on which you listened to anything.

panels.title: New artists

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT min(played_at) AS first_played FROM v_plays GROUP BY lower(artist)) f WHERE $__timeFilter(first_played)

panels.description: Artists you first played in the selected range (going by your whole history).

panels.title: Shuffle

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * avg(shuffle::integer), 0) FROM v_plays WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at)

panels.description: Share of plays with shuffle on. Only Spotify data exports say this (the app's own recordings can't), so it covers plays up to your latest import.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('$bucket', local_time) AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM settings) AS time, round(sum(seconds) / 3600.0, 2) AS "Hours" FROM v_plays WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Year by year

targets.rawSql: WITH p AS (SELECT extract(year FROM local_time)::integer AS year, * FROM v_plays), songs AS (SELECT year, max(track_name) || ' – ' || max(artist) AS name, COALESCE((array_agg(album_image) FILTER (WHERE album_image IS NOT NULL))[1], 'data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7') AS cover, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY count(*) DESC) AS n FROM p GROUP BY year, lower(artist), lower(track_name)), artists AS (SELECT year, max(artist) AS name, COALESCE((array_agg(artist_image) FILTER (WHERE artist_image IS NOT NULL))[1], 'data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7') AS picture, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY count(*) DESC) AS n FROM p GROUP BY year, lower(artist)), albums AS (SELECT year, max(album_name) || ' – ' || max(artist) AS name, COALESCE((array_agg(album_image) FILTER (WHERE album_image IS NOT NULL))[1], 'data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7') AS cover, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY count(*) DESC) AS n FROM p WHERE album_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year, lower(artist), lower(album_name)), firsts AS (SELECT min(extract(year FROM local_time)::integer) AS year FROM v_plays GROUP BY lower(artist)), totals AS (SELECT year, round(sum(seconds) / 3600.0, 1) AS hours, count(*) AS plays, count(DISTINCT lower(artist)) AS artists FROM p GROUP BY year) SELECT t.year::text AS "Year", t.hours AS "Hours", t.plays AS "Plays", s.cover AS "Song cover", s.name AS "Top song", a.picture AS "Artist picture", a.name AS "Top artist", al.cover AS "Album cover", al.name AS "Top album", t.artists AS "Artists", (SELECT count(*) FROM firsts f WHERE f.year = t.year) AS "New artists" FROM totals t LEFT JOIN songs s ON s.year = t.year AND s.n = 1 LEFT JOIN artists a ON a.year = t.year AND a.n = 1 LEFT JOIN albums al ON al.year = t.year AND al.n = 1 ORDER BY t.year DESC

panels.description: Your own Wrapped for every year: top song, artist and album, and how many artists you heard and discovered (first played that year). All time, not limited by the time range.

panels.title: Days listened

targets.rawSql: SELECT w.week AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM settings) AS time, round(COALESCE(sum(p.seconds) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM p.local_time) = 7), 0) / 3600.0, 2) AS "Sun", round(COALESCE(sum(p.seconds) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM p.local_time) = 6), 0) / 3600.0, 2) AS "Sat", round(COALESCE(sum(p.seconds) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM p.local_time) = 5), 0) / 3600.0, 2) AS "Fri", round(COALESCE(sum(p.seconds) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM p.local_time) = 4), 0) / 3600.0, 2) AS "Thu", round(COALESCE(sum(p.seconds) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM p.local_time) = 3), 0) / 3600.0, 2) AS "Wed", round(COALESCE(sum(p.seconds) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM p.local_time) = 2), 0) / 3600.0, 2) AS "Tue", round(COALESCE(sum(p.seconds) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM p.local_time) = 1), 0) / 3600.0, 2) AS "Mon" FROM generate_series(date_trunc('week', $__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM settings)), $__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM settings), interval '1 week') AS w (week) LEFT JOIN v_plays p ON date_trunc('week', p.local_time) = w.week AND $__timeFilter(p.played_at) GROUP BY w.week ORDER BY w.week

panels.description: Hours of listening per day over the last year, one column per week (like GitHub's contribution graph). Not limited by the time range.

panels.title: Longest listening sessions

targets.rawSql: WITH p AS (SELECT played_at, seconds, artist, played_at - make_interval(secs => seconds) AS started_at, lag(played_at) OVER (ORDER BY played_at) AS previous_end FROM v_plays WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at)), s AS (SELECT *, sum(CASE WHEN previous_end IS NULL OR started_at - previous_end > interval '20 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY played_at) AS session FROM p) SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sum(seconds) DESC) AS "#", min(started_at) AS "Started", round(sum(seconds) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Hours", count(*) AS "Songs", mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY artist) AS "Mostly" FROM s GROUP BY session ORDER BY sum(seconds) DESC LIMIT 25

panels.description: Stretches of listening with no break longer than 20 minutes. Mostly = the artist you played most in it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY count(*) DESC, max(played_at) DESC) AS "#", COALESCE((array_agg(album_image) FILTER (WHERE album_image IS NOT NULL))[1], 'data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7') AS "Cover", max(track_name) AS "Song", max(artist) AS "Artist", count(*) AS "Plays" FROM v_plays WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at) AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM local_time) < 4 GROUP BY lower(artist), lower(track_name) ORDER BY count(*) DESC, max(played_at) DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY count(*) DESC, max(played_at) DESC) AS "#", COALESCE((array_agg(artist_image) FILTER (WHERE artist_image IS NOT NULL))[1], 'data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7') AS "Picture", max(artist) AS "Artist", count(*) AS "Plays", round(sum(seconds) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Hours", count(DISTINCT lower(track_name)) AS "Songs" FROM v_plays WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at) GROUP BY lower(artist) ORDER BY count(*) DESC, max(played_at) DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY count(*) DESC, max(played_at) DESC) AS "#", COALESCE((array_agg(album_image) FILTER (WHERE album_image IS NOT NULL))[1], 'data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7') AS "Cover", max(track_name) AS "Song", max(artist) AS "Artist", count(*) AS "Plays" FROM v_plays WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at) GROUP BY lower(artist), lower(track_name) ORDER BY count(*) DESC, max(played_at) DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Top albums

targets.rawSql: SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY count(*) DESC, max(played_at) DESC) AS "#", COALESCE((array_agg(album_image) FILTER (WHERE album_image IS NOT NULL))[1], 'data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7') AS "Cover", max(album_name) AS "Album", max(artist) AS "Artist", count(*) AS "Plays" FROM v_plays WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at) AND album_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lower(artist), lower(album_name) ORDER BY count(*) DESC, max(played_at) DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: The basic data export has no albums, so its plays aren't counted here.

panels.title: Obsessions: most plays of one song in a day

targets.rawSql: SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY count(*) DESC, max(played_at) DESC) AS "#", local_time::date AS "Day", COALESCE((array_agg(album_image) FILTER (WHERE album_image IS NOT NULL))[1], 'data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7') AS "Cover", max(track_name) AS "Song", max(artist) AS "Artist", count(*) AS "Plays" FROM v_plays WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at) GROUP BY local_time::date, lower(artist), lower(track_name) ORDER BY count(*) DESC, max(played_at) DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Forgotten favourites: not played in a year

targets.rawSql: SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY count(*) DESC, max(played_at) DESC) AS "#", COALESCE((array_agg(album_image) FILTER (WHERE album_image IS NOT NULL))[1], 'data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7') AS "Cover", max(track_name) AS "Song", max(artist) AS "Artist", count(*) AS "Plays", max(played_at) AS "Last played" FROM v_plays GROUP BY lower(artist), lower(track_name) HAVING max(played_at) < now() - interval '1 year' ORDER BY count(*) DESC, max(played_at) DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Your most played songs ever that you haven't played for over a year. All time, not limited by the time range.

panels.title: New artists per $bucket

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('$bucket', first_played AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM settings)) AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM settings) AS time, count(*) AS "New artists" FROM (SELECT lower(artist) AS key, max(artist) AS artist, min(played_at) AS first_played, count(*) AS plays, COALESCE((array_agg(artist_image) FILTER (WHERE artist_image IS NOT NULL))[1], 'data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7') AS picture FROM v_plays GROUP BY lower(artist)) f WHERE $__timeFilter(first_played) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Artists you played for the first time ever (going by your whole history).

panels.title: Artists you found in this range

targets.rawSql: SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY plays DESC, first_played) AS "#", picture AS "Picture", artist AS "Artist", first_played AS "First played", plays AS "Plays" FROM (SELECT lower(artist) AS key, max(artist) AS artist, min(played_at) AS first_played, count(*) AS plays, COALESCE((array_agg(artist_image) FILTER (WHERE artist_image IS NOT NULL))[1], 'data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7') AS picture FROM v_plays GROUP BY lower(artist)) f WHERE $__timeFilter(first_played) ORDER BY plays DESC, first_played LIMIT 50

panels.description: Artists first played in the selected range, by how much you've played them since (ever).

panels.title: Devices

targets.rawSql: SELECT device AS "Device", round(sum(seconds) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Hours" FROM v_plays WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at) AND device IS NOT NULL GROUP BY device ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: Hours per kind of device. Only Spotify data exports say this (the app's own recordings can't), so it covers plays up to your latest import.

panels.title: Countries

targets.rawSql: SELECT country AS "Country", round(sum(seconds) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Hours" FROM v_plays WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at) AND country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.description: Where you listened (two-letter country codes). Only Spotify data exports say this (the app's own recordings can't), so it covers plays up to your latest import.

panels.title: Most skipped songs

targets.rawSql: SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY count(*) FILTER (WHERE skip) DESC, avg(skip::integer) DESC) AS "#", COALESCE((array_agg(album_image) FILTER (WHERE album_image IS NOT NULL))[1], 'data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7') AS "Cover", max(track_name) AS "Song", max(artist) AS "Artist", count(*) FILTER (WHERE skip) AS "Skips", round(100.0 * avg(skip::integer)) AS "Skip rate" FROM v_song_starts WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at) GROUP BY lower(artist), lower(track_name) HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE skip) > 0 ORDER BY count(*) FILTER (WHERE skip) DESC, avg(skip::integer) DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Songs you skipped most: moved to the next or previous song, or - in its first 30 seconds - picked something else or stopped. Skip rate = skips / times the song started (including starts under 30 s, which don't count as plays anywhere else). Only Spotify data exports say this (the app's own recordings can't), so it covers plays up to your latest import.

panels.title: Recently played

targets.rawSql: SELECT played_at AS "Played", COALESCE(album_image, 'data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7') AS "Cover", track_name AS "Song", array_to_string(artist_names, ', ') AS "Artists", album_name AS "Album", device AS "Device", context_type AS "From", source AS "Source" FROM v_plays WHERE $__timeFilter(played_at) ORDER BY played_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: Played = when the song ended. From = album, playlist, artist page, ... (recorded plays only). Device: data exports only. Source: api = recorded by the app, export = imported from a Spotify data export.
